release_read.basis: Revenue $17.1bn beat the ~$16.85bn consensus the hunt cited (so the thesis that consensus sat above the base case failed), operating EPS $2.95 vs Nasdaq $2.88, FCF guide raised, software +8% (+9% cc) and Red Hat +11%; offset by flat consulting, gross margin down 20-50bp and an unchanged 4-5% cc revenue guide after a +7.4% run-up on a name that has sold 5 of 8 beats.

release.headline: IBM third-quarter 2026 results: revenue $17.1bn up 5% (6% cc), software up 8%, FCF outlook raised

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast in brief (fallback, 6 estimates)

key_line.detail: Software $7.8bn up 8% (9% cc), Red Hat up 11%; consulting flat (2% cc); infrastructure up 4%. Street software expectation not verified in time.

guidance.detail: FY26 cc revenue growth 4-5% maintained; free cash flow now expected to rise more than $1bn year over year (raised). Revenue guide not raised despite the beat.

call.detail: Call held 17:00 ET 2026-10-21; content not reviewed for lack of time. The after-hours slide (-4.6%) deepening to -7.7% pre-market suggests the call or the segment detail (consulting flat, margins down, unraised revenue guide) disappointed.

public_reaction.summary: Constellation Research: 'IBM Q3 strong, carried by AI, IBM Z mainframe'. No analyst actions searched (time limit); retail tone not checked.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 232.07 = -7.71% vs prev close 251.46, beyond the 6.76% implied move and far below the frozen release read of +1.5%. Pre-market is active (200 prints, 31 in the last 30 min, last 09:17, not stale) and sagged from after-hours -4.64% and a pre-market high of 240.90 to near the 231.00 low. Market is also weak (SPY -0.94%). The short is up about 5.1% from entry 245.21.

thesis_check.note: The headline lines contradict the thesis (revenue and EPS beat, FCF raised), but the stock is being sold hard anyway, consistent with the 'sells beats after a run-up' half of the thesis.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market on a mega-cap, so the open should hold nearly all of the -7.7%; a gap beyond the implied move against a beat-and-raise release tends to give part back in the first half hour.

recommendation.reason: De short staat al ongeveer 5% in de winst en de koers zakt voorbeurs verder dan de opties voorspelden, terwijl de cijfers zelf (omzet en winst boven verwachting, hogere kasstroomprognose) zo'n daling niet rechtvaardigen. Grote dalingen na cijfers herstellen vaak deels na de opening, dus dek de short bij de opening, zoals de standaardregel zegt.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als vóór 09:30 analisten massaal koersdoelen verlagen of er een duidelijk slecht nieuwtje uit de call blijkt (bijvoorbeeld een zwakke softwareprognose), kan vasthouden tot later in de dag beter zijn.

searched_and_found_nothing: analyst actions and call commentary not searched (time limit)
